reason: My bookkeeper and I already run everything through our expense app and it works well enough. Half of what I spend is cash to mechanics with no proper receipt, so another $19 a month for a second tool that reads photos doesn't make sense for me.
objection: I don't believe it really catches duplicates. Two invoices for the same spare part on different days look the same to a bot, and my cash payments to mechanics never show up in a chat anyway. Then I'm paying twice to do the same bookkeeping.
would_change_my_mind: If I run my old chat through the free 30 documents and it finds a real double payment or a wrong amount that my current app and bookkeeper missed, worth more than a few months of the fee.
